name: Globus Spirits Ltd
title: Globus Spirits Ltd - 533104 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Globus Q4 FY26: bulk EBITDA INR8.3/l and 80% utilisation, but Q4 volume dented by ENA inventory build; capacity now 334 MLPA with no fundraise needed, net debt INR627 cr.

utilisation.quote: For the year, we achieved a strong 80% capacity utilization, adjusting for the UP start -up period.

capex.quote: I foresee somewhere between INR60 crores to INR80 crores of capex sustaining for a few years.

triggers.label: Q4 ENA inventory build, liquidates Q1
triggers.quote: This friction resulted in a one-time inventory buildup at our facilities during Q4.

triggers.label: Bulk EBITDA INR6.3/l FY26 within INR5-7
triggers.quote: We achieved INR6.3 in Q4 and that's within that INR5 to INR7 range.

triggers.label: Fundraise put on hold
triggers.quote: the plan for capital raise -- equity capital raise has been put on hold.

triggers.label: Delhi R&O volumes stopped by policy
triggers.quote: As of the end of Q4, we decided until the policy is not stabilized, we will not operate in Delhi.

guidance.quote: INR5 to INR7 is our guidance for the EBITDA per liter.
So well over 20 crores will be the target for this year.
INR500 crores is what we have called out.
I think our target in this space is 16% to 18%.

prior_guidance_check.quote: FY26 was that range and FY27, we expect the same range.

red_flags.label: Q4 P&A EBITDA loss INR5 cr; Delhi R&O volumes halted
red_flags.quote: Overall, the segment generated an EBITDA level loss of INR5 crores in the quarter

red_flags.label: Fundraise enabling resolutions kept open
red_flags.quote: we are in no immediate pressure to dilute equity at this stage.

evasions.quote: We are not prepared to give you the numbers immediately on this call.

evasions.topic: UP monthly volumes and realisation per case
evasions.quote: We don't release it. We don't release it.

summary.headline: Globus Spirits FY26 P&A revenue rose 27% to INR164 crores, while Q4 manufacturing EBITDA was INR8.3/litre and the company dropped its equity raise.
summary.overview: Globus Spirits closed FY26 with installed capacity of 334 million litres after the UP distillery commissioning, at 80% utilisation (adjusted for UP start-up). Manufacturing EBITDA was INR6.2/litre for FY26 and INR8.3/litre in Q4, while Q4 volumes dipped on an ENA shift and a one-time inventory build-up that management expects to clear in Q1. Consumer P&A grew 27% for the year (58% excluding Delhi), but Q4 P&A EBITDA loss widened to INR5 crores, partly due to INR3-3.5 crores of label registration costs. Management said internal accruals and debt refinancing (annual debt outflow cut from INR67 crores to INR14 crores for FY27) mean there is no immediate need for the equity raise.

financial_highlights.change: Q4 later stated as INR6.3 in Q&A

segments.name: Manufacturing (bulk alcohol: ENA, ethanol, exports)
segments.commentary: FY26 bulk sales about 199.5 million litres, roughly 70:30 ethanol to ENA, with guidance of more than 20 crore litres in FY27 plus UP volumes (about 2 crore litres). Q4 exports started at 3.7 million litres; Q4 volume dipped on ENA shift and inventory build-up.

segments.name: Prestige & Above (P&A)
segments.commentary: FY26 revenue INR164 crores (+27%), volume 1.19 million cases; 5 core markets with 4 profitable; Delhi share fell to 23% of volume after a Q3 disruption, and Delhi recovered to 90% of Q4 FY25 volume.

segments.name: Regular & Others (R&O)
segments.commentary: FY26 revenue INR900 crores and 15.7 million cases; Q4 EBITDA margin about 18%, which management expects to ease to 16-18% range as UP grows. Rajasthan plus UP volume grew 7% in FY26, with other markets degrowing.

guidance_outlook: Manufacturing EBITDA guided at INR5-7 per litre for FY27, same as FY26 range, regardless of ENA or ethanol mix.
Bulk sales target above 20 crore litres for FY27 excluding UP; UP expected to add about 2 crore litres.
FY27 interest cost expected around INR14-15 crores per quarter after UP capitalisation ended; refinancing saves about INR50 crores in FY27 with debt outflow of INR14 crores.
Equity fundraise put on hold; FY27 expansion to be funded from internal accruals, with the enabling resolution still valid.
R&O Rajasthan plus UP volume growth expected above 7% in FY27; Q1 to see West Bengal volume (marginal) and inventory liquidation.
FY29 targets reaffirmed: P&A revenue around INR500 crores with about 50% growth, and presence in at least 8 more states.
Maintenance capex INR40-50 crores per year, plus INR20-30 crores for malt whiskey ageing and bottling, INR60-80 crores total for a few years.
capex_capacity: Installed capacity 334 million litres per annum after the UP distillery commissioning in the prior quarter; 6 distilleries across North and East India.
FY26 capacity utilisation 80% (adjusted for UP start-up), within the 80-85% annual guidance.
Eastern plants shifting from rice to maize derate capacity by 75 KL per day per plant when run fully on maize.
Facilities in Haryana, Bihar and UP geared for large-scale ENA exports.
Capex: maintenance INR40-50 crores, plus INR20-30 crores for whiskey ageing and bottling, INR60-80 crores sustained for a few years.
demand_pricing: Delhi volumes in Q3 FY26 fell to 60% of Q3 FY25; Q4 recovered to 90%. Management says the Delhi P&A business grew 58% ex-Delhi in FY26.
P&A realisation impacted by mix; management said price/mix contributed about 3% of growth.
Rajasthan price increase of INR30 per case replicated for FY27; no price increase yet in UP or Haryana.
ENA carries a lower realisation than ethanol, which lowered Q4 revenue; management says this is market structure, not a pricing issue.
Scotch import tariff cut expected to offset part of raw material and packaging cost inflation from the Middle East situation.
Management expects ethanol blending demand to grow strongly and flex-fuel mandates to add demand.
Global ENA supply constraints from high energy costs are creating export opportunities.

qa_highlights.question: Is the company giving a P&A growth target for FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: Management is committed to the FY29 target of about 50% growth in P&A but will not give piecemeal annual guidance; the FY29 P&A figure is INR500 crores, not INR1,000 crores.

qa_highlights.question: Why did Q4 P&A EBITDA loss widen to INR5 crores?
qa_highlights.answer: About INR3-3.5 crores of label registration costs were paid for new brand launches timed for Jan-Feb, plus investment in East expansion and Jharkhand; core markets are described as 4 of 5 profitable.

qa_highlights.question: Why did R&O growth slow and how much did Delhi affect it?
qa_highlights.answer: Management declined to give Delhi case numbers; UP and Rajasthan together grew 7% in volume, while Delhi, West Bengal and Haryana drove flat overall volume. Delhi R&O is paused until policy stabilises.

qa_highlights.question: What is the interest cost trajectory after Q4?
qa_highlights.answer: Q4 interest rose about INR3 crores because UP term loan interest stopped being capitalised; guided INR14-15 crores per quarter going forward.

qa_highlights.question: What are the net debt and working capital levels?
qa_highlights.answer: Net debt is INR627 crores at Q4 exit; R&O working capital is 5-6 days and expected to rise slightly from Q1.

qa_highlights.question: How does the company plan to expand into new states?
qa_highlights.answer: Expansion may use third-party manufacturing (e.g., Assam) or captive units depending on efficiency; 8 new states is the minimum baked into the FY29 plan.

qa_highlights.question: Will the company disclose realisation per case or UP volumes?
qa_highlights.answer: Management does not release realisation per case by category or separate UP volumes currently; it will consider disclosure internally.

risks_watch: Q1 FY27 volume recovery depends on clearing the Q4 ENA inventory build-up and state permission cycles.
Input cost inflation (PET, packaging, freight, fuel) tied to the Middle East situation; management says the impact is modest but has not quantified it.
Delhi R&O policy remains unstable and paused; West Bengal relaunch depends on licence transfer timing.
R&O margin expected to fall from 18% toward 16-18% as UP (lower-margin) grows.
P&A losses are volatile quarter to quarter; the FY29 targets rely on emerging markets moving to core.
Bihar prohibition reversal is a potential upside but timing is uncertain.
Management did not give separate UP numbers or realisation per case, limiting visibility.
summary.management_tone: Confident on the long-term plan and the UP and Bihar opportunity, but cautious on near-term quarterly P&A losses and Delhi, which management declined to quantify. Management was evasive on Delhi R&O numbers and realisation per case, and it corrected several analyst assumptions (P&A target, Q4 margin).
key_quotes: We are in no immediate pressure to dilute equity at this stage.
Our revised business plan demonstrates a cash flow trajectory that is stronger than was initially projected around Q2 or Q3 of last year, allowing us to self-fund our current growth initiatives.
INR5 to INR7 is our guidance for the EBITDA per liter. That's the range in which it will remain for the year.
Delhi volumes in Q3 FY26 dropped drastically to 60% of the Q3 FY25 volumes.

adds.what: UP distillery commissioned (installed capacity now 334 million litres per annum across 6 distilleries)
UP bulk volume addition of about 2 crore litres in FY27

growth.why: FY27 bulk volume guided to well over 20 crore litres (plus about 2 crore litres from UP) and P&A revenue target of INR500 crore by FY29 (about 50% growth), backed by the commissioned UP distillery and Rajasthan price increase, though no specific P&A capacity or order numbers were given and Delhi operations were halted.
